name: Rustomjee Paramount
address: 18th Road, Vithaldas Nagar, Khar West, Mumbai 400052
amenities: Rooftop sky lounge with sea-view dining
RFID tags for children and pets; CCTV in children's zone
description: Gated community of several wings (A to F) in Khar West, built by Rustomjee (Keystone Realtors) and designed to be senior-friendly. It has 2 to 5 BHK homes with sun decks, two homes per floor in the early wings, and interiors by Sanjay Puri. Wings A and B received their occupation certificate in Sep 2017 and Wings D and E in Nov 2018. Wing F was still under construction in 2026.
notes: Keystone's DRHP (June 2022) says Paramount was launched in 2014 on 3.50 acres. Its average price rose 2.06x, from Rs 17,535 to Rs 36,129 per sq ft saleable at OC, with a lifetime average of Rs 28,153. Cumulative sales were Rs 1,357 crore, with 91.17% of inventory sold as of 31 Dec 2021. The DRHP also says 39 of Khar's 101 redevelopment units launched in 2017-2021 were in Paramount, so at least part of it (likely Wing F) is redevelopment; land_type is left out. Land area conflicts: the DRHP gives 3.50 acres, while Square Yards and Free Press Journal (2024) give 1.65 acres, perhaps for the RERA-registered phases only. Wings A and B: commencement certificate Nov 2015, handover from Aug 2018 (DRHP). The OC for Wings D and E was reported on 2 Nov 2018. Wing F (P51800020843): commencement 15 May 2019, original completion 30 Dec 2025, revised to 30 Dec 2026, with internal finishing at 87-96% in Apr 2026 (Square Yards). Floors are given as 22 or 24 storeys in listings (units are registered up to the 22nd floor), so floors_max is omitted. flats_per_floor = 2 comes from the 2017 OC release for the early wings. Notable owners: Tiger Shroff bought two flats from Keystone in 2018 and sold them in 2025 and 2026. Square Yards' 12-month registered tally (2 sales, Rs 5 Cr, Nov 2025-Oct 2026) doesn't seem to include Shroff's Rs 9 Cr sale registered on 22 Oct 2026. Same-basis comparison (Nov 2026 top-up): on carpet area there is a completion price (Tiger Shroff's two 2018 purchases from Keystone, Rs 58,400-58,940) and resale prices (Rs 57,079-78,403, 2024-26), but no carpet-basis launch price; on the DRHP's saleable basis there are launch and completion prices but no resale. Registered deeds give a 'built-up' area only 10-19% above carpet (1,609.53 vs 1,357.77; 2,189 vs 1,989.72 sq ft), far below the roughly 1.6x implied by the DRHP saleable averages, so they are not used as saleable-basis resale points. No 2014 launch price on carpet area was found, and PropertyButler shows no registered sales for the building.
architect: Sanjay Puri Architects (Mumbai) with Patty Mak (Suying Metropolitan, Singapore)

news.title: Rustomjee Paramount receives occupancy certificate for A and B wing
news.summary: Wings A and B received their OC. Rustomjee offered ready homes for a 15% payment, with the balance due by Oct 2018.

news.title: Rustomjee Paramount welcomes Tiger Shroff to the 'League of Extraordinary Gentleman'
news.summary: Rustomjee announced actor Tiger Shroff as a buyer. He registered a Rs 7.61 Cr flat purchase on 17 Jul 2018 and bought a second flat for Rs 11.62 Cr in 2018.

news.title: Rustomjee Paramount receives occupancy certificate for D and E wing
news.summary: Wings D and E received their occupation certificate.

news.title: Marathi filmmaker Avadhoot Gupte acquires Rs 7.7 crore apartment in Bandra's Rustomjee Paramount
news.summary: Rs 7.75 Cr for 1,357.77 sq ft carpet with 3 car parks, registered Oct 2024 (Square Yards documents).

news.title: Tiger Shroff sells Khar apartment for Rs 15.60 crore, records 34% value gain
news.summary: A 1,989.72 sq ft carpet flat bought for Rs 11.62 Cr in 2018 was resold for Rs 15.60 Cr, about Rs 78,400/sq ft carpet.

news.title: Tiger Shroff sells Mumbai flat for Rs 9 crore
news.summary: A 9th-floor 1,291 sq ft carpet flat bought from Keystone for Rs 7.61 Cr in 2018 was sold for Rs 9 Cr. The date given is the registration date; the article's publication date isn't shown.
